# m3u8dl

> A multi-threaded m3u8 video downloader written in Go.

m3u8dl downloads an m3u8 playlist's TS segments concurrently, supports AES
decryption, nested/master playlists, ad dedup and resume-from-breakpoint, then
merges them into a single MP4 using system `ffmpeg` (built-in merge fallback).

## Core Facts

- License: MIT
- Language: Go (Go 1.27+), cobra for the CLI
- Module: `github.com/dingdayu/m3u8dl`
- Install: `go install github.com/dingdayu/m3u8dl@latest`
- Repo: https://github.com/dingdayu/m3u8dl
- Docs (human): https://github.com/dingdayu/m3u8dl/blob/main/README.md

## Quick Usage (for Agents)

Always prefer `--json`; results print to **stdout**, logs to **stderr**:

```bash
m3u8dl --url https://example.com/index.m3u8 --json
# {"ok":true,"path":".../movie.mp4","duration_sec":12.3,"mode":"single",...}
```

Common flags:

| Flag | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-u/--url` | m3u8 URL (or first positional arg) | — |
| `-n/--threads` | download concurrency | 24 |
| `-o/--output` | output filename (no ext) | `movie` |
| `--host-type` | v1 / v2 / auto host resolution | `v2` |
| `--purge-dup` | remove ad/duplicate segments | off |
| `--save-path` | output directory | current dir |
| `-j/--json` | structured JSON result | off |
| `-l/--list` | batch list file, one URL per line | — |
| `-s/--insecure` | allow insecure TLS | off |

Exit code is non-zero on failure. On partial failure, the ts directory is kept;
re-running the same command resumes only the missing segments.
